item.title: House fire in Opp
item.description: DOTHAN, Ala (WDHN) -- A house fire broke out in Opp Wednesday morning on Beulah Church Road, according to a post on Opp Fire Department's Facebook. Opp Fire Department dispatched at 7:15 a.m. Wednesday and arrived to find heavy smoke from the rear of the house with everyone standing outside, uninjured. No injuries were reported. [...]

item.title: Drugmakers plan to raise US prices on at least 350 medications: Report
item.description: The cost of at least 350 drugs in the U.S. are expected to rise in 2026, according to a new analysis, despite many of the drugmakers pledging to offer more favorable prices under new Trump administration policies.

item.title: Trump says there's 'nothing’s wrong' with his health, got CT scan not MRI
item.description: President Trump disputed the idea that there was anything wrong with his health and clarified that he got a CT scan instead of an MRI scan when he visited Walter Reed National Military Medical Center for a “secondary” physical.

item.title: 10 pricey medications now cheaper for Medicare Part D enrollees: What to know
item.description: There’s good news in 2026 for seniors enrolled in Medicare Part D who rely on the priciest prescription drugs: 10 high-cost medications that treat a variety of chronic conditions will be significantly cheaper beginning Jan. 1.
